name: Microscope Slide
instruction: Can you create a 3D model of a microscope slide with a specimen on it?

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a microscope slide.
The slide is rectangular in shape.
The specimen is placed in the center of the slide.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The specimen is appropriately sized for the slide.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The slide is flat and positioned horizontally.
The specimen is correctly placed on the slide without overlap.
Object distance and contact: The specimen is in direct contact with the slide.
There are no gaps between the specimen and the slide.

Instruction execution accuracy: The model accurately represents a microscope slide with a specimen.
All specified attributes are included in the design.
